prompt_en: Create a full-body 35 mm fashion photograph in a rain-cleared rooftop greenhouse in Seoul at cobalt blue hour. Use the attached portrait only for visible adult appearance: a clearly adult woman with long dark center-parted softly waved hair, warm brown eyes, natural makeup, and a calm expression. She steps between wet planters while fastening a lemon mini bag at her hip. She wears an ivory ribbed fitted tank, a featherlight blue striped overshirt lifting in the breeze, black fitted capri trousers, and pointed low-profile ballet flats. Ensure two independent trouser legs remain readable through the crotch and stride; both trouser hems end below the knees around mid-calf; bare lower-leg gaps continue from both hems to the ankles on each side; left and right hems share the same readable calf landmark; the visible calf gaps distinguish this length from knee shorts and ankle crops. Keep both knees, hems, ankles, and shoes visible together. Planter rows and roof ribs converge behind her moving figure. Cool roof light and one amber practical outline both hems.
